# Saved reports for the end-to-end test

These files are not recordings. No provider was called to make them.

`anthropic-usage.json` follows the shape of `internal/reconcile/testdata/documentation-samples/anthropic/usage.json`, with the token counts of the recorded `subagent` run and a synthetic key id. `anthropic-cost.json` is empty, because that run was billed to a subscription and has no bill to compare.
